name: Exec Cluster E03: Notional Sizing Mode
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E03: Notional Sizing
# Tests: position_size(type=SizeType.notional)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.ema)(close)
is_bull = fast > slow
held = hold_until(is_bull, not is_bull)

long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.notional)(size=50000)

stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)
